00083 BufferChannelInternal::BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw()
00084 : data(0),
00085   size_(size),
00086   allocatedSize(size),
00087   currentWriteBlockID(-1),
00088   circularHead(-1), previousCircularHead(-1)
00089 {
00090   ugen_assert(size > 0);

00096   if(size > sourceDataSize)
00097   {
00098     memcpy(data, sourceData, sourceDataSize * sizeof(float));
00099     memset(data + sourceDataSize, 0, (size - sourceDataSize) * sizeof(float));
00100   }
00101   else
00102   {
00103     memcpy(data, sourceData, size * sizeof(float));
00104   }
00105 
00106 #ifdef BUFFERTESTMEMORY
00107   reportDataPtr(data, size_);
00108 #endif

00111 BufferChannelInternal::BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw()
00112 : size_(size),
00113   allocatedSize(size),
00114   currentWriteBlockID(-1),
00115   circularHead(-1), previousCircularHead(-1)
00116 {
00117   ugen_assert(size >= 2);
00118   
00119   data = new float[size_];
00120   double inc = (end - start) / (size_ - 1);
00121   double currentValue = start;
00122   float *outputSamples = data;
00123   
00124   int numSamples = size_;
00125   while(--numSamples >= 0)
00126   {
00127     *outputSamples++ = (float)currentValue;
00128     currentValue += inc;
00129   } 
00130   
00131 #ifdef BUFFERTESTMEMORY
00132   reportDataPtr(data, size_);
00133 #endif  
00134 }

00509 double Buffer::initFromJuceFile(const File& audioFile) throw()
00510 {
00511   if((audioFile == File::nonexistent) || (audioFile.exists() == false))
00512   {
00513     ugen_assertfalse;
00514     return 0.0;
00515   }
00516   
00517   AudioFormatManager formatManager;
00518   formatManager.registerBasicFormats();
00519   
00520 //#if JUCE_QUICKTIME
00521 //  formatManager.registerFormat(new QuickTimeAudioFormat(), false);
00522 //#endif
00523   
00524   AudioFormatReader* audioFormatReader = formatManager.createReaderFor (audioFile);
00525   
00526   if(audioFormatReader == 0) return 0.0;
00527   
00528   double sampleRate = audioFormatReader->sampleRate;
00529   numChannels_ = audioFormatReader->numChannels;
00530   size_ = (int)audioFormatReader->lengthInSamples;
00531   channels = new BufferChannelInternal*[numChannels_];
00532   
00533   float** bufferData = new float*[numChannels_];
00534   
00535   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00536   {
00537     channels[i] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, false);
00538     bufferData[i] = channels[i]->data;
00539   }
00540   
00541   if(size_ > 0)
00542   {
00543     AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, numChannels_, size_);
00544     audioSampleBuffer.readFromAudioReader(audioFormatReader, 0, size_, 0, true, true);
00545   }
00546   else
00547   {
00548     sampleRate = 0.0;
00549   }
00550   
00551   delete audioFormatReader;
00552   delete [] bufferData;
00553   return sampleRate;
00554 }

00578 bool Buffer::initFromJuceFile(const File& audioFile, 
00579                 bool overwriteExisitingFile, 
00580                 int bitDepth) throw()
00581 { 
00582   File outputFile;
00583   
00584   if(audioFile.isDirectory()) 
00585     outputFile = audioFile.getChildFile(getFileNameWithTimeIdentifier(T("Buffer")));
00586   else
00587     outputFile = audioFile;
00588     
00589   if(outputFile.getFileExtension().isEmpty())
00590     outputFile = outputFile.withFileExtension(T("wav"));
00591   
00592   if(overwriteExisitingFile == true && outputFile.exists())
00593     outputFile.deleteFile();
00594   else if(outputFile.exists())
00595     return false;
00596   
00597   AudioFormatWriter* audioFormatWriter;
00598   
00599   if(outputFile.hasFileExtension(".wav"))
00600   {
00601     WavAudioFormat wavAudioFormat;
00602     FileOutputStream* fileOutputStream = outputFile.createOutputStream();
00603     
00604     if(!fileOutputStream) return false;
00605     
00606     audioFormatWriter = wavAudioFormat.createWriterFor(fileOutputStream, 
00607                                UGen::getSampleRate(), 
00608                                getNumChannels(), 
00609                                bitDepth, 0, 0);
00610   }
00611   else if(outputFile.hasFileExtension(".aif") || outputFile.hasFileExtension(".aiff"))
00612   {
00613     AiffAudioFormat aiffAudioFormat;
00614     FileOutputStream* fileOutputStream = outputFile.createOutputStream();
00615     
00616     if(!fileOutputStream) return false;
00617     
00618     audioFormatWriter = aiffAudioFormat.createWriterFor(fileOutputStream, 
00619                               UGen::getSampleRate(), 
00620                               getNumChannels(), 
00621                               bitDepth, 0, 0);
00622   }
00623   
00624   float **bufferData = new float*[getNumChannels()];
00625   memset(bufferData, 0, getNumChannels() * sizeof(float*));
00626   
00627   for(int i = 0; i < getNumChannels(); i++)
00628   {
00629     bufferData[i] = getData(i);
00630   }
00631   
00632   AudioSampleBuffer audioSampleBuffer(bufferData, getNumChannels(), size());
00633   audioSampleBuffer.writeToAudioWriter(audioFormatWriter, 0, size());
00634   
00635   delete audioFormatWriter;
00636   delete [] bufferData;
00637   
00638   return true;
00639 }

00672 double Buffer::initFromAudioFile(const char* audioFilePath) throw()
00673 {
00674   Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00675   
00676   if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00677   { 
00678     path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Bundle, audioFilePath);
00679     audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00680   }
00681   
00682   if (audioFilePath == 0 || audioFilePath[0] == 0) 
00683   {
00684     printf("Buffer: File path is null (perhaps it doesn't exist?\n");
00685     return 0.0;
00686   }
00687   
00688   OSStatus result;
00689   UInt32 dataSize;
00690   
00691   CFURLRef audioFileURL;
00692   audioFileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL,
00693                                (const UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00694                                strlen(audioFilePath), 
00695                                false);
00696   
00697   AudioFileID audioFile;
00698   result = AudioFileOpenURL (audioFileURL, kAudioFileReadPermission, 0, &audioFile);
00699   CFRelease(audioFileURL);
00700   if (result != noErr) 
00701   {
00702     printf("Buffer: Could not open file: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00703     return 0.0;
00704   }
00705   
00706   SInt64 packetCount;
00707   dataSize = sizeof(packetCount);
00708   result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyAudioDataPacketCount, &dataSize, &packetCount);
00709   if (result != noErr) 
00710   {
00711     printf("Buffer: Could not get packet count: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00712     AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00713     return 0.0;
00714   }
00715   
00716   AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
00717   dataSize = sizeof(format);
00718   result = AudioFileGetProperty(audioFile, kAudioFilePropertyDataFormat, &dataSize, &format);
00719   if (result != noErr) 
00720   {
00721     printf("Buffer: Could not get data format: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00722     AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00723     return 0.0;
00724   }
00725   
00726   void* audioData = malloc(format.mBytesPerFrame * packetCount);
00727   
00728   if(audioData)
00729   {
00730     UInt32 packetsRead = packetCount;
00731     UInt32 numBytesRead = -1;
00732     result = AudioFileReadPackets(audioFile, false, &numBytesRead, NULL, 0, &packetsRead, audioData); 
00733     
00734     if (result != noErr) 
00735     {
00736       printf("Buffer: Could not read audio packets: %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00737       free(audioData);
00738       AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00739       return 0.0;
00740     }
00741     
00742     numChannels_ = format.mChannelsPerFrame;
00743     size_ = packetsRead;
00744     channels = new BufferChannelInternal*[numChannels_];
00745     
00746     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
00747     {
00748       channels[i] = new BufferChannelInternal(size_, false);
00749     }
00750     
00751     if(format.mFormatID != kAudioFormatLinearPCM)
00752     {
00753       printf("Buffer: Only PCM formats supported\\n");
00754       clear();
00755     }
00756     else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsFloat) != 0)
00757     {
00758       // float format, just need to deinterleave
00759       for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00760       {
00761         float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00762         float* audioFileSamples = (float*)audioData + channel;
00763         int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00764         
00765         if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00766         {
00767           // big endian float
00768           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00769           {
00770             *bufferSamples = bigEndianFloat((const char*)audioFileSamples);
00771             bufferSamples++;
00772             audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00773           }
00774         }
00775         else
00776         {
00777           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00778           {
00779             *bufferSamples = *audioFileSamples;
00780             bufferSamples++;
00781             audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00782           }
00783         }
00784       }
00785     }
00786     else if((format.mFormatFlags & kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian) != 0)
00787     {
00788       // aif and other big edian?
00789       if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00790       {
00791         const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00792         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00793         {
00794           float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00795           SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00796           int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00797           
00798           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00799           {
00800             *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian16Bit((const char*)audioFileSamples) * factor;
00801             bufferSamples++;
00802             audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00803           }
00804         }
00805       }
00806       else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00807       {
00808         const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFFFF;
00809         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00810         {
00811           float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00812           SInt32* audioFileSamples = (SInt32*)audioData + channel;
00813           int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00814           
00815           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00816           {
00817             *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian32Bit((const char*)audioFileSamples) * factor;
00818             bufferSamples++;
00819             audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00820           }
00821         }
00822       }
00823       else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00824       {
00825         const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFF;
00826         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00827         {
00828           float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00829           char* audioFileSamples = (char*)audioData + (channel * 3);
00830           int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00831           
00832           const int intInc = numChannels_ * 3;
00833           
00834           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00835           {
00836             *bufferSamples = (float)bigEndian24Bit(audioFileSamples) * factor;
00837             bufferSamples++;
00838             audioFileSamples += intInc;
00839           }
00840         }
00841       }
00842       else
00843       {
00844         printf("Buffer: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00845         clear();
00846       }
00847     }
00848     else
00849     {
00850       // wav and other little edian?
00851       if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 16)
00852       {
00853         const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFF;
00854         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00855         {
00856           float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00857           SInt16* audioFileSamples = (SInt16*)audioData + channel;
00858           int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00859           
00860           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00861           {
00862             *bufferSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00863             bufferSamples++;
00864             audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00865           }
00866         }
00867       }
00868       else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 32)
00869       {
00870         const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFFFF;
00871         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00872         {
00873           float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00874           SInt32* audioFileSamples = (SInt32*)audioData + channel;
00875           int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00876           
00877           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00878           {
00879             *bufferSamples = (float)(*audioFileSamples) * factor;
00880             bufferSamples++;
00881             audioFileSamples += numChannels_;
00882           }
00883         }
00884       }
00885       else if(format.mBitsPerChannel == 24)
00886       {
00887         const float factor = 1.0 / 0x7FFFFF;
00888         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
00889         {
00890           float* bufferSamples = channels[channel]->data;
00891           char* audioFileSamples = (char*)audioData + (channel * 3);
00892           int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
00893           
00894           const int intInc = numChannels_ * 3;
00895           
00896           while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00897           {
00898             *bufferSamples = (float)littleEndian24Bit(audioFileSamples) * factor;
00899             bufferSamples++;
00900             audioFileSamples += intInc;
00901           }
00902         }
00903       }
00904       else
00905       {
00906         printf("Buffer: Sound file format not yet supported.");
00907         clear();
00908       }
00909     }
00910   }
00911   else
00912   {
00913     printf("Buffer: Could not allocate memory for audio : %s err=%d\n", audioFilePath, (int)result);
00914   }
00915   
00916   free(audioData);
00917   AudioFileClose(audioFile);
00918   
00919   return format.mSampleRate;
00920 }
00921 
00922 bool Buffer::write(Text const& audioFilePath, 
00923            bool overwriteExisitingFile, 
00924            int bitDepth) throw()
00925 {
00926   ugen_assert(bitDepth >= 16);
00927   
00928   enum AudioFileType { WAV, AIFF };
00929   AudioFileType type;
00930   
00931   TextArray split = audioFilePath.split(".");
00932   int splitLength = split.length();
00933   
00934   Text pathChecked; 
00935   if(splitLength <= 1)
00936   {
00937     pathChecked = audioFilePath << ".wav";
00938     type = WAV;
00939   }
00940   else
00941   {
00942     pathChecked = audioFilePath;
00943     if(split.last().equalsIgnoreCase("aif") || 
00944        split.last().equalsIgnoreCase("aiff"))
00945     {
00946       type = AIFF;
00947     }
00948     else
00949     {
00950       type = WAV;
00951     }
00952   }
00953     
00954   if(type == AIFF)
00955   {
00956     if(bitDepth == 24)
00957       return initFromAudioFileAiff24(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00958     else if(bitDepth == 32)
00959       return initFromAudioFileAiff32(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00960     else
00961     {
00962       if(bitDepth != 16)
00963         printf("Buffer: warning: bit depth of %d not supported, using 16\n", bitDepth);
00964       return initFromAudioFileAiff16(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00965     }
00966   }
00967   else if(type == WAV)
00968   {
00969     if(bitDepth == 24)
00970       return initFromAudioFileWav24(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00971     else if(bitDepth == 32)
00972       return initFromAudioFileWav32(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00973     else
00974     {
00975       if(bitDepth != 16)
00976         printf("Buffer: warning: bit depth of %d not supported, using 16\n", bitDepth);
00977       return initFromAudioFileWav16(pathChecked.getArray(), overwriteExisitingFile);
00978     }
00979   }
00980   
00981   return false;
00982 }
00983 
00984 bool Buffer::initFromAudioFileWav16(const char* audioFilePath, 
00985                   bool overwriteExisitingFile) throw()
00986 { 
00987   ugen_assert(audioFilePath != 0);
00988   
00989   Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
00990   
00991   if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
00992   { 
00993     path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Documents, audioFilePath);
00994     audioFilePath = path.getArray();
00995   }
00996   
00997   CFURLRef fileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, 
00998                                  (UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
00999                                  strlen(audioFilePath), 
01000                                  false);
01001   
01002   AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
01003   
01004   const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
01005   
01006   format.mChannelsPerFrame  = numChannels;
01007   format.mSampleRate      = UGen::getSampleRate();
01008   format.mFormatID      = kAudioFormatLinearPCM;
01009   format.mFormatFlags     = kAudioFormatFlagIsSignedInteger | kAudioFormatFlagIsPacked;
01010   format.mBitsPerChannel    = 16;
01011   format.mBytesPerFrame   = format.mChannelsPerFrame * format.mBitsPerChannel / 8;
01012   format.mFramesPerPacket   = 1;
01013   format.mBytesPerPacket    = format.mBytesPerFrame * format.mFramesPerPacket;
01014   
01015   AudioFileID audioFile;
01016   OSStatus status = AudioFileCreateWithURL(fileURL,
01017                        kAudioFileWAVEType,
01018                        &format,
01019                        overwriteExisitingFile ? kAudioFileFlags_EraseFile : 0,
01020                        &audioFile);
01021   
01022   if(status) return false;
01023   
01024   UInt32 sizeInBytes = format.mBytesPerFrame;
01025   SInt16 intValues[numChannels];
01026   
01027   const float factor = 0x7FFF;
01028   
01029   const int numSamples = size();
01030   for(int sample = 0; sample < numSamples; sample++)
01031   {
01032     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
01033     {
01034       intValues[channel] = (SInt16)(getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample) * factor);
01035     }
01036         
01037     UInt32 ioNumPackets = 1;
01038     status = AudioFileWritePackets(audioFile,
01039                      false,
01040                      sizeInBytes,
01041                      NULL,
01042                      sample,
01043                      &ioNumPackets,
01044                      intValues);
01045     
01046     if(ioNumPackets == 0)
01047     {
01048       printf("Buffer: error: writing file\n");
01049       AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01050       return false;
01051     }
01052   }
01053   
01054   AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01055   return true;
01056 }

01319   OSStatus status = AudioFileCreateWithURL(fileURL,
01320                        kAudioFileWAVEType,
01321                        &format,
01322                        overwriteExisitingFile ? kAudioFileFlags_EraseFile : 0,
01323                        &audioFile);
01324   
01325   if(status) return false;
01326   
01327   UInt32 sizeInBytes = format.mBytesPerFrame;
01328   SInt32 intValues[numChannels];
01329   
01330   const float factor = 0x7FFFFFFF;
01331   
01332   const int numSamples = size();
01333   for(int sample = 0; sample < numSamples; sample++)
01334   {
01335     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
01336     {
01337       intValues[channel] = (SInt32)(getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample) * factor);
01338     }
01339     
01340     UInt32 ioNumPackets = 1;
01341     status = AudioFileWritePackets(audioFile,
01342                      false,
01343                      sizeInBytes,
01344                      NULL,
01345                      sample,
01346                      &ioNumPackets,
01347                      intValues);
01348     
01349     if(ioNumPackets == 0)
01350     {
01351       printf("Buffer: error: writing file\n");
01352       AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01353       return false;
01354     }
01355   }
01356   
01357   AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01358   return true;
01359 }

01361 bool Buffer::initFromAudioFileAiff32(const char* audioFilePath, 
01362                    bool overwriteExisitingFile) throw()
01363 {
01364   ugen_assert(audioFilePath != 0);
01365   
01366   Text path; // this needs to be here so it doesn't get garbage collected too early
01367   
01368   if(audioFilePath[0] != '/')
01369   { 
01370     path = NSUtilities::pathInDirectory(NSUtilities::Documents, audioFilePath);
01371     audioFilePath = path.getArray();
01372   }
01373   
01374   CFURLRef fileURL = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, 
01375                                  (UInt8*)audioFilePath, 
01376                                  strlen(audioFilePath), 
01377                                  false);
01378   
01379   AudioStreamBasicDescription format;
01380   
01381   const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
01382   
01383   format.mChannelsPerFrame  = numChannels;
01384   format.mSampleRate      = UGen::getSampleRate();
01385   format.mFormatID      = kAudioFormatLinearPCM;
01386   format.mFormatFlags     = kAudioFormatFlagIsBigEndian | kAudioFormatFlagIsSignedInteger | kAudioFormatFlagIsPacked;
01387   format.mBitsPerChannel    = 32;
01388   format.mBytesPerFrame   = format.mChannelsPerFrame * format.mBitsPerChannel / 8;
01389   format.mFramesPerPacket   = 1;
01390   format.mBytesPerPacket    = format.mBytesPerFrame * format.mFramesPerPacket;
01391   
01392   AudioFileID audioFile;
01393   OSStatus status = AudioFileCreateWithURL(fileURL,
01394                        kAudioFileAIFFType,
01395                        &format,
01396                        overwriteExisitingFile ? kAudioFileFlags_EraseFile : 0,
01397                        &audioFile);
01398   
01399   if(status) return false;
01400   
01401   UInt32 sizeInBytes = format.mBytesPerFrame;
01402   SInt32 intValues[numChannels];
01403   
01404   const float factor = 0x7FFFFFFF;
01405   
01406   const int numSamples = size();
01407   for(int sample = 0; sample < numSamples; sample++)
01408   {
01409     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
01410     {
01411       intValues[channel] = (SInt32)(getSampleUnchecked(channel, sample) * factor);
01412       intValues[channel] = bigEndian32Bit((const char*)&intValues[channel]);
01413     }
01414     
01415     UInt32 ioNumPackets = 1;
01416     status = AudioFileWritePackets(audioFile,
01417                      false,
01418                      sizeInBytes,
01419                      NULL,
01420                      sample,
01421                      &ioNumPackets,
01422                      intValues);
01423     
01424     if(ioNumPackets == 0)
01425     {
01426       printf("Buffer: error: writing file\n");
01427       AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01428       return false;
01429     }
01430   }
01431   
01432   AudioFileClose(audioFile);
01433   return true;
01434 }

01457 void Buffer::decrementInternals() throw()

01467 
01468 Buffer Buffer::interleave() throw()
01469 {
01470   if(size_ < 1 || numChannels_ < 1) return Buffer();
01471   
01472   Buffer intervleavedBuffer = BufferSpec(size_ * numChannels_, 1, false);
01473   
01474   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
01475   {
01476     int numSamplesToProcess = size_;
01477     const float * srcSamples = getData(channel);
01478     float* dstSamples = intervleavedBuffer.getData() + channel;
01479     
01480     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
01481     {
01482       *dstSamples = *srcSamples++;
01483       dstSamples += numChannels_;
01484     }
01485   }
01486   
01487   return intervleavedBuffer;
01488 }
01489 
01490 Buffer Buffer::deinterleave(const int numInterleavedChannels) throw()
01491 {
01492   ugen_assert(numChannels_ == 1);
01493   ugen_assert((size_ % numInterleavedChannels) == 0);
01494   
01495   const int newSize = size_ / numInterleavedChannels;
01496   Buffer deintervleavedBuffer = BufferSpec(newSize, 
01497                        numInterleavedChannels, 
01498                        false);
01499   
01500   for(int channel = 0; channel < numInterleavedChannels; channel++)
01501   {
01502     int numSamplesToProcess = newSize;
01503     const float * srcSamples = getData() + channel;
01504     float* dstSamples = deintervleavedBuffer.getData(channel);
01505     
01506     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
01507     {
01508       *dstSamples++ = *srcSamples;
01509       srcSamples += numInterleavedChannels;
01510     }
01511   }
01512   
01513   return deintervleavedBuffer;  
01514 }

01521 void Buffer::copyFrom(Buffer const& source, const int sourceOffset, const int destOffset, const int numSamples) throw()
01522 {
01523   ugen_assert(getNumChannels() > 0);
01524   ugen_assert(source.getNumChannels() > 0);
01525   ugen_assert(size() > 0);
01526   ugen_assert(source.size() > 0);
01527   ugen_assert((destOffset+numSamples) <= size());
01528   ugen_assert((sourceOffset+numSamples) <= source.size());
01529   
01530   for(int channel = 0; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
01531   {
01532     float *destData = getData(channel);
01533     const float* sourceData = source.getData(channel % source.getNumChannels());
01534     
01535     memcpy(destData, sourceData, sizeof(float) * numSamples);
01536   }

01773 
01774 Buffer Buffer::getRegion(const int startSample, 
01775              const int endSample, 
01776              const int startChannel, 
01777              const int endChannel) const throw()
01778 {
01779   int newSize, newNumChannels;
01780   int sampleStep = 1, channelStep = 1;
01781   int currentChannel;
01782   
01783   if(endSample == -1)
01784     newSize = size_ - startSample;
01785   else if(endSample > startSample)
01786     newSize = endSample - startSample + 1;
01787   else
01788   {
01789     newSize = startSample - endSample + 1;
01790     sampleStep = -1;
01791   }
01792   
01793   if(startChannel == -1)
01794   {
01795     currentChannel = 0;
01796     newNumChannels = numChannels_;
01797   }
01798   else
01799   {
01800     currentChannel = startChannel;
01801     
01802     if(endChannel == -1)
01803       newNumChannels = numChannels_ - startChannel;
01804     else if(endChannel > startChannel)
01805       newNumChannels = endChannel - startChannel + 1;
01806     else
01807     {
01808       newNumChannels = startChannel - endChannel + 1;
01809       channelStep = -1;
01810     }
01811   }
01812   
01813   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, newNumChannels, false));
01814   
01815   for(int newChannelIndex = 0; newChannelIndex < newNumChannels; newChannelIndex++, currentChannel += channelStep)
01816   {
01817     const float *inputSamples = getData(currentChannel) + startSample;
01818     
01819     float *outputSamples = newBuffer.getData(newChannelIndex);
01820     int numSamples = newSize;
01821     
01822     while(numSamples--)
01823     {
01824       *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples;
01825       inputSamples += sampleStep;
01826     }
01827   }
01828   
01829   return newBuffer;
01830 }

01841     size_ -= amount;
01842   }
01843   
01844   return *this;

01846 
01847 float Buffer::sum(const int channel) const throw()
01848 {
01849   if(numChannels_ == 0 || channel < 0 || channel >= numChannels_) 
01850   {
01851     ugen_assertfalse;
01852     return 0.f;
01853   }
01854   
01855   int numSamples = size_;
01856   float* inputSamples = channels[channel]->data;
01857   float total = 0.f;
01858   
01859   while(--numSamples >= 0) {
01860     total += *inputSamples++;
01861   }
01862   
01863   return total;
01864 }
01865 
01866 float Buffer::sum() const throw()
01867 {
01868   if(numChannels_ == 0) 
01869   {
01870     ugen_assertfalse;
01871     return 0.f;
01872   }
01873   
01874   float total = 0.f;
01875   
01876   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
01877   {
01878     total += sum(channel);
01879   }
01880   
01881   return total;
01882 }

01884 Buffer Buffer::normalise() const throw()

01891     return *this;

01894 Buffer Buffer::normaliseEach() const throw()

01909 float Buffer::findMaximum(const int channel) const throw()
01910 {
01911   if(numChannels_ == 0 || size_ == 0) 
01912   {
01913     ugen_assertfalse;
01914     return 0.f;
01915   }
01916   
01917   float value;
01918   
01919   if(channel >= 0)
01920   {
01921     value = getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0);
01922     for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)
01923     {
01924       float newValue = getSampleUnchecked(channel, i);
01925       value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01926     }
01927   }
01928   else
01929   {
01930     value = getSampleUnchecked(0, 0);
01931     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01932     {
01933       float newValue = findMaximum(i);
01934       value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01935     }
01936   }
01937   
01938   return value;
01939 }
01940 
01941 float Buffer::findMinimum(const int channel) const throw()
01942 {
01943   if(numChannels_ == 0 || size_ == 0) 
01944   {
01945     ugen_assertfalse;
01946     return 0.f;
01947   }
01948   
01949   float value;
01950   
01951   if(channel >= 0)
01952   {
01953     value = getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0);
01954     for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)
01955     {
01956       float newValue = getSampleUnchecked(channel, i);
01957       value = newValue < value ? newValue : value;
01958     }
01959   }
01960   else
01961   {
01962     value = getSampleUnchecked(0, 0);
01963     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01964     {
01965       float newValue = findMinimum(i);
01966       value = newValue < value ? newValue : value;
01967     }
01968   }
01969   
01970   return value;

01972 
01973 float Buffer::findPeak(const int channel) const throw()
01974 {
01975   if(numChannels_ == 0 || size_ == 0) 
01976   {
01977     ugen_assertfalse;
01978     return 0.f;
01979   }
01980   
01981   float value;
01982   
01983   if(channel >= 0)
01984   {
01985     value = getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0);
01986     for(int i = 0; i < size_; i++)
01987     {
01988       float newValue = ugen::abs(getSampleUnchecked(channel, i));
01989       value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01990     }
01991   }
01992   else
01993   {
01994     value = getSampleUnchecked(0, 0);
01995     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels_; i++)
01996     {
01997       float newValue = findPeak(i);
01998       value = newValue > value ? newValue : value;
01999     }
02000   }
02001   
02002   return value;

02004 
02005 Buffer Buffer::blend(Buffer const& other, double dfraction) const throw()
02006 {
02007   if(size_ == 0 || numChannels_ == 0) return other;
02008     
02009   ugen_assert(dfraction >= -1.0 && dfraction <= 1.0);
02010   
02011   const int newNumChannels = ugen::max(numChannels_, other.numChannels_);
02012   const int maxSize = ugen::max(size_, other.size_);
02013   const int minSize = ugen::min(size_, other.size_);
02014 
02015   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));
02016   
02017   if(dfraction >= 0.0)
02018   {   
02019     float fraction = ugen::clip((float)dfraction, 0.f, 1.f);
02020     
02021     for(int channel = 0; channel < newNumChannels; channel++)
02022     {
02023       const int thisChannel = channel % getNumChannels();
02024       const int otherChannel = channel % other.getNumChannels();
02025       
02026       for(int sample = 0; sample < minSize; sample++)
02027       {
02028         float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
02029         float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
02030         float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction) + otherValue * fraction;
02031         newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
02032       }
02033       
02034       if(size_ < other.size_)
02035       {
02036         for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
02037         {
02038           float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
02039           float newValue = otherValue * fraction;
02040           newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
02041         }
02042       }
02043       else
02044       {
02045         for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
02046         {
02047           float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
02048           float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction);
02049           newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
02050         }     
02051       }
02052     }
02053   }
02054   else
02055   {
02056     float fraction = ugen::neg(ugen::clip((float)dfraction, -1.f, 0.f));
02057     
02058     for(int channel = 0; channel < newNumChannels; channel++)
02059     {
02060       const int thisChannel = channel % getNumChannels();
02061       const int otherChannel = channel % other.getNumChannels();
02062       
02063       for(int sample = 0; sample < minSize; sample++)
02064       {
02065         float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
02066         float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
02067         float newValue = otherValue > thisValue ?  // peak hold
02068           otherValue : thisValue * (1.f-fraction) + otherValue * fraction;
02069         newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
02070       }
02071       
02072       if(size_ < other.size_)
02073       {
02074         for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
02075         {
02076           float otherValue = other.getSampleUnchecked(otherChannel, sample);
02077           float newValue = otherValue;
02078           newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
02079         }
02080       }
02081       else
02082       {
02083         for(int sample = minSize; sample < maxSize; sample++)
02084         {
02085           float thisValue = getSampleUnchecked(thisChannel, sample);
02086           float newValue = thisValue * (1.f-fraction);
02087           newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, newValue);
02088         }     
02089       }
02090     }   
02091   }
02092   
02093   return newBuffer;
02094 }

02177 
02178 Buffer Buffer::loopFade(const float fadeTime, 
02179             EnvCurve const& fadeInShape, 
02180             EnvCurve const& fadeOutShape) const throw()
02181 {
02182   ugen_assert(fadeTime >= 0.f);
02183   
02184   const int fadeSize = fadeTime * UGen::getSampleRate();
02185   
02186   if(fadeSize >= size_ || fadeSize == 0) return *this;
02187   
02188   const int newSize = size_ - fadeSize;
02189   
02190   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, numChannels_, false));
02191   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
02192   {
02193     float *outputSamples = newBuffer.getData(channel);
02194     //memcpy(outputSamples, getDataReadOnly(channel), newSize * sizeof(float));
02195     memcpy(outputSamples, getData(channel), newSize * sizeof(float));
02196     
02197     //const float* inputSamples = getDataReadOnly(channel) + newSize;
02198     const float* inputSamples = getData(channel) + newSize;
02199     
02200     int numSamplesToProcess = fadeSize;
02201     float fadeInLevel = 0.f;
02202     float fadeOutLevel = 1.f;
02203     float fadeSlope = 1.f / fadeSize;
02204     
02205     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
02206     {
02207       float fadeIn = *outputSamples;
02208       float fadeOut = *inputSamples;
02209       
02210       *outputSamples = fadeIn * fadeInLevel + fadeOut * fadeOutLevel;     
02211             
02212       fadeInLevel += fadeSlope;
02213       fadeOutLevel -= fadeSlope;
02214       inputSamples++;
02215       outputSamples++;
02216     }
02217   }
02218   
02219   return newBuffer;
02220 }
02221 
02222 Buffer Buffer::resample(const int newSize) const throw()
02223 {
02224   ugen_assert(newSize > 0);
02225   
02226   if(size_ == 0 || size_ == newSize)
02227   {
02228     return *this;
02229   }
02230   else
02231   {
02232     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(newSize, numChannels_, false));
02233     
02234     double reciprocalNewSize = 1.0 / (double)(newSize-1);
02235     
02236     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels_; channel++)
02237     {
02238       for(int sample = 0; sample < newSize; sample++)
02239       {
02240         float value = lookup(channel, (double)sample * reciprocalNewSize);
02241         newBuffer.setSampleUnchecked(channel, sample, value);
02242       }
02243     }
02244     
02245     return newBuffer;
02246   }
02247 }
02248 
02249 Buffer Buffer::changeSampleRate(const double oldSampleRate, const double newSampleRateIn) const throw()
02250 {
02251   const double newSampleRate = newSampleRateIn == 0.0 ? UGen::getSampleRate() : newSampleRateIn;
02252   
02253   if(oldSampleRate == newSampleRate)
02254   {
02255     return *this;
02256   }
02257   else
02258   {
02259     return resample(size_ * (newSampleRate / oldSampleRate));
02260   }
02261 }

02357 Buffer Buffer::triangleWindow(const int size) throw()
02358 {
02359   const int rampUpSize = size/2;
02360   const int rampDownSize = size-rampUpSize;
02361   Buffer rampUp = Buffer::line(rampUpSize+2, 0.0, 1.0).shrinkSize(1).getRegion(1);
02362   Buffer rampDown = Buffer::line(rampDownSize+1, 1.0, 0.0).shrinkSize(1);
02363   return (rampUp, rampDown);
02364 }

02366 Buffer Buffer::bartlettWindow(const int size) throw()
02367 {
02368   const int rampUpSize = size/2;
02369   const int rampDownSize = size-rampUpSize;
02370   Buffer rampUp = Buffer::line(rampUpSize+1, 0.0, 1.0).shrinkSize(1);
02371   Buffer rampDown = Buffer::line(rampDownSize, 1.0, 0.0);
02372   return (rampUp, rampDown);
02373 }

02375 Buffer Buffer::hannWindow(const int size) throw()
02376 {

02380 Buffer Buffer::hammingWindow(const int size) throw()
02381 {

02385 Buffer Buffer::blackmanWindow(const int size, const float alpha) throw()
02386 {
02387   float a0 = (1.f-alpha) * 0.5f;
02388   float a1 = 0.5f;
02389   float a2 = alpha * 0.5f;
02390   
02391   return -cosineTable(size) * a1 + cosineTable(size, 2.f) * a2 + a0;
02392 }

02406 Buffer Buffer::synth(const int size, UGen const& graph_) throw()
02407 {
02408   UGen graph = graph_;  
02409   ugen_assert(size > 0);
02410   
02411   int numChannels = graph.getNumChannels();
02412   ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
02413   
02414   Buffer result = Buffer::withSize(size, numChannels);
02415   
02416   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
02417   {
02418     graph.setOutput(result.getData(i), size, i);
02419   }
02420   
02421   graph.prepareAndProcessBlock(size, 0, 0);
02422   
02423   return result;  
02424 }
02425 
02426 void Buffer::synthInPlace(UGen const& graph_, const int offset, const int numSamples_) throw()
02427 {
02428   UGen graph = graph_;  
02429   
02430   int numSamples = (numSamples_ <= 0) ? size() : numSamples_;
02431   ugen_assert(numSamples > 0);
02432   
02433   int numChannels = ugen::min(getNumChannels(), graph.getNumChannels());
02434   ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
02435     
02436   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
02437   {
02438     graph.setOutput(getData(i) + offset, numSamples, i);
02439   }
02440     
02441   graph.prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, 0, 0);
02442   
02443   if(numChannels < getNumChannels())
02444   {
02445     for(int channel = numChannels; channel < getNumChannels(); channel++)
02446     {
02447       memcpy(getData(channel) + offset, 
02448            getData(channel % numChannels) + offset, 
02449            sizeof(float) * numSamples);
02450     }
02451   } 
02452 }
02453 
02454 void Buffer::synthAndSend(const int size, UGen const& graph, BufferReceiver* receiver, const int bufferID) throw()
02455 {
02456   ugen_assert(receiver != 0);
02457   
02458   Buffer result = synth(size, graph);
02459   receiver->handleBuffer(result, 0.0, bufferID);  
02460 }

02504 Buffer Buffer::reciprocalExceptZero() const throw()
02505 {
02506   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));
02507   
02508   for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)
02509   {
02510     int numSamples = size_;
02511     float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;
02512     float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;
02513     
02514     while(--numSamples >= 0) {
02515       float value = *inputSamples++;
02516       if(value == 0.f || value == -0.f)
02517         *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
02518       else
02519         *outputSamples++ = 1.f / value;
02520     }
02521   }
02522   
02523   return newBuffer;
02524 }
02525 
02526 Buffer Buffer::reverse() const throw()
02527 {
02528   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));
02529   
02530   for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)
02531   {
02532     int numSamples = size_;
02533     float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data + numSamples - 1;
02534     float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;
02535     
02536     while(--numSamples >= 0) {
02537       *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples--;
02538     }
02539   }
02540   
02541   return newBuffer;
02542 }
02543 
02544 Buffer Buffer::mix() const throw()
02545 {
02546   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, 1, true));
02547   
02548   int channelIndex = 0;
02549   
02550   do
02551   {
02552     int numSamples = size_;
02553     float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;
02554     float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[0]->data;
02555     
02556     while(--numSamples >= 0) {
02557       *outputSamples++ += *inputSamples++;
02558     }
02559     
02560     channelIndex++;
02561   }
02562   while(channelIndex < numChannels_);
02563   
02564   return newBuffer;
02565 }

02567 Buffer Buffer::process(UGen const& input_, UGen const& graph_, const int offset, const int numSamples_) const throw()
02568 {
02569   UGen input = input_;
02570   UGen graph = graph_;
02571   
02572   int numSamples = (numSamples_ <= 0) ? size() : numSamples_;
02573   ugen_assert(numSamples > 0);
02574   
02575   int numChannels = ugen::min(getNumChannels(), graph.getNumChannels());
02576   ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
02577     
02578   Buffer result = Buffer::withSize(numSamples, numChannels);
02579     
02580   for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
02581   {
02582     input.setInput(getData(i) + offset, numSamples, i);
02583     graph.setOutput(result.getData(i), numSamples, i);
02584   }
02585   
02586   graph.prepareAndProcessBlock(numSamples, 0, 0);
02587   
02588   return result;
02589 }

02728 ComplexBuffer ComplexBuffer::operator+ (ComplexBuffer const& rightOperand) const throw()
02729 {
02730   ComplexBuffer newBuffer(size_);
02731   
02732   const float *leftRealSamples = getDataRealReadOnly();
02733   const float *leftImagSamples = getDataImagReadOnly();
02734   const float *rightRealSamples = rightOperand.getDataRealReadOnly();
02735   const float *rightImagSamples = rightOperand.getDataImagReadOnly();
02736   float *newRealSamples = newBuffer.getDataReal();
02737   float *newImagSamples = newBuffer.getDataImag();
02738   
02739   int numSamples = size_;
02740   
02741   while(numSamples--)
02742   {
02743     *newRealSamples++ = *leftRealSamples++ + *rightRealSamples++;
02744     *newImagSamples++ = *leftImagSamples++ + *rightImagSamples++;
02745   }
02746   
02747   return newBuffer;
02748 }
02749 
02750 ComplexBuffer ComplexBuffer::operator- (ComplexBuffer const& rightOperand) const throw()
02751 {
02752   ComplexBuffer newBuffer(size_);
02753   
02754   const float *leftRealSamples = getDataRealReadOnly();
02755   const float *leftImagSamples = getDataImagReadOnly();
02756   const float *rightRealSamples = rightOperand.getDataRealReadOnly();
02757   const float *rightImagSamples = rightOperand.getDataImagReadOnly();
02758   float *newRealSamples = newBuffer.getDataReal();
02759   float *newImagSamples = newBuffer.getDataImag();
02760   
02761   int numSamples = size_;
02762   
02763   while(numSamples--)
02764   {
02765     *newRealSamples++ = *leftRealSamples++ - *rightRealSamples++;
02766     *newImagSamples++ = *leftImagSamples++ - *rightImagSamples++;
02767   }
02768   
02769   return newBuffer;
02770 }

02772 ComplexBuffer ComplexBuffer::operator* (ComplexBuffer const& rightOperand) const throw()
02773 {
02774   ComplexBuffer newBuffer(size_);
02775   
02776   const float *leftRealSamples = getDataRealReadOnly();
02777   const float *leftImagSamples = getDataImagReadOnly();
02778   const float *rightRealSamples = rightOperand.getDataRealReadOnly();
02779   const float *rightImagSamples = rightOperand.getDataImagReadOnly();
02780   float *newRealSamples = newBuffer.getDataReal();
02781   float *newImagSamples = newBuffer.getDataImag();
02782   
02783   int numSamples = size_;
02784   
02785   while(numSamples--)
02786   {
02787     *newRealSamples++ = (*leftRealSamples * *rightRealSamples) - (*leftImagSamples * *rightImagSamples);
02788     *newImagSamples++ = (*leftImagSamples * *rightRealSamples) + (*leftRealSamples * *rightImagSamples);
02789     leftRealSamples++;
02790     leftImagSamples++;
02791     rightRealSamples++;
02792     rightImagSamples++;
02793   }
02794     
02795   return newBuffer;
02796 }
